h1: Video production, animation and AI video for Dallas companies
intro: We make video for established Dallas companies without the overhead of a studio day for every clip. Short-form reels, brand films, motion graphics, animated explainers, AI video and managed editing teams, plus live broadcast for events. Corporate headquarters, healthcare groups, property firms and retail brands across DFW use us for steady, on-brand output every month.

sections.h: The real video problem is volume
p: Most Dallas marketing teams do not need one expensive brand film. They need a steady flow: four reels a week for social, a product explainer for sales, a recruiting video for a new Frisco location, captions in English and Spanish, and cut-downs for every ad format. A traditional shoot-and-edit studio is built for the big piece, not the weekly rhythm.

The video production Dallas companies get from us is built around that rhythm. We plan a monthly content calendar, use footage you already have or can capture easily, and fill the gaps with motion graphics, animation and AI video.

list: Short-form video and reels for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.
Brand films and company stories for websites, recruiting and investor audiences.
Motion graphics: animated data, product features and branded templates.
Animated explainers in 2D and 3D for products and services that are hard to film.
AI video: AI presenters, ad variations and generated scenes, clearly labeled and reviewed by a person.
Managed editing teams that turn your raw footage into finished content every week.
Live broadcast and streaming for events, launches and town halls.
Corporate headquarters in Las Colinas, Legacy West and Downtown: internal announcements, town hall broadcasts, onboarding series and culture videos for recruiting.

Healthcare systems and practices: patient education, procedure explainers in 2D or 3D animation, and clinic introductions, with medical claims reviewed before release.

sections.h: How a project or a monthly retainer works
p: Talk: a short call about what you need and where it will run. Plan: we write the content calendar or the script, storyboard it, list the footage needed and agree dates. Build: we edit, animate and produce, with review rounds on a shared link where you comment on exact frames. Grow: we look at which videos perform on each channel and shift the next month's plan toward what works.
If a project needs new footage filmed in Dallas, we plan that with you as part of the scope, including what to shoot so every minute of filming produces several pieces of content.

AI video is useful for ad variations, multilingual versions, presenter-led explainers and backgrounds that would be costly to film. We label it clearly, a person reviews every piece, and we never create a likeness of a real person without their written consent.

That last point matters in Texas, which has its own law on capturing and using biometric identifiers such as face geometry and voiceprints. If an AI presenter is built from one of your own staff, consent and data handling are agreed in writing first, and your counsel can review the approach.

sections.h: Proof: live events and managed editing
p: We have run and broadcast more than 20 large-scale live events. The lesson from live work is simple: the date does not move, so planning, backups and rehearsals are not optional. We bring the same discipline to monthly content. We also run a managed video editing team for a US client, turning raw footage into finished content on a fixed weekly schedule.

We handle Dallas video work remotely from London, with meeting hours that overlap Central Time. Dallas is six hours behind, so footage you upload at the end of your day can be edited while you sleep, and a first cut is often waiting when your team logs on. Review calls sit in the Dallas morning.
For live broadcasts and shoots, we plan on-site support in Dallas when the project needs it, agreed in the scope well before the date.
We scope each project or retainer. The factors that shape the budget:
list: Volume: number of videos per month and their length.
Whether footage is supplied, filmed or created through animation and AI.
Languages, captions and formats per video.
Live broadcast needs, such as multiple cameras or streaming platforms.

p: Video works best when it is planned with the campaign, the website and the search strategy, and we run all of those. The same team that edits your reels can run the ads they appear in and build the landing page they point to. Related services for Dallas companies: 3D rendering, paid media and SEO and GEO.

faqs.q: Do you have a film crew in Dallas?
faqs.a: No, and we will not claim one. We work with Dallas companies remotely from London, with meeting hours that overlap Central Time. Much of our output uses existing footage, simple capture by your team, motion graphics, animation or AI video. When a project needs filming or live broadcast support in Dallas, we plan it in the scope.

faqs.q: Can you edit footage our team films on phones?
faqs.a: Yes. Many Dallas clients capture short clips on a phone and upload them to a shared folder. We give your team a simple shot list, then our editors turn the raw footage into finished reels, captions and cut-downs on a weekly schedule.

faqs.q: What is a managed editing team?
faqs.a: It is a set editing capacity each month, run by us, for companies with a steady flow of footage. You send raw material, we return finished videos to an agreed schedule and brand style. It suits Dallas marketing and internal comms teams that need volume without hiring editors.

faqs.q: Is AI video safe to use for a Dallas brand?
faqs.a: It is when used carefully. We label AI content, have a person review every piece, and never create a real person's likeness without written consent. Texas has its own biometric identifier law, so if an AI presenter is based on your staff, we agree consent and data handling in writing first.

faqs.q: Can you make Spanish versions of our videos for DFW audiences?
faqs.a: Yes. Spanish captions, voiceovers and on-screen text are a regular part of the video production Dallas clients order from us, especially in healthcare, retail and home services. We adapt scripts rather than translating word for word, and every version is checked by a fluent speaker, on our side or yours, before release.

faqs.q: Can you broadcast our town hall or launch event live?
faqs.a: Yes. We have run and broadcast more than 20 large-scale live events. For a Dallas town hall or launch, we plan streaming, graphics, backups and rehearsals, and agree any on-site support in Dallas as part of the scope well before the date.

faqs.q: How quickly can you turn around a video?
faqs.a: A short reel from supplied footage can often be turned around within a few working days, and the time difference means edits often progress overnight Dallas time. Animated explainers and brand films take longer because of scripting and review. Dates for each piece go in writing.
